title: Spinning test particles in a weak gravitational wave and the memory effect
summary: In this work, we investigate the worldline deviation of spinning test particles in a weak gravitational wave (GW) spacetime. Within the pole-dipole approximation and the Tulczyjew spin supplementary condition, we consider the modified deviation equation, which contains the standard geodesic deviation term and an additional contribution generated by the Mathisson-Papapetrou-Dixon (MPD) force.
